create_opt_dict: create an Opt dict instance to track options with automatic history logging of all key-value changes
save_opt_to_json: save an Opt object to a JSON file on disk with autoclean keys automatically removed
load_opt_from_file: load an Opt object from a JSON or pickled file on disk back into memory
load_opt_preset: load an Opt from a bundled preset, user preset, or comma-separated list of preset files
display_opt_history: display the change history for a specific key showing all values and stack trace locations
